title: Preservation of the active invariant
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, let $\tau$ be rational with $0<\tau\le 1$, and let $E$ assign a rational estimate to each restricted Fourier weight. Let $k<n$ and let $\mathcal A$ be a finite family of frequency sets. If $\mathcal A$ satisfies the active invariant at stage $k$, and every candidate at stage $k$ has estimated restricted Fourier weight within $\tau^2/4$ of its true restricted Fourier weight, then the family retained by the stated candidate and threshold rule satisfies the active invariant at stage $k+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$E$ assigns a rational estimate for every coordinate set and subset of it
$\mathcal A$ is a finite family of frequency sets
The active invariant holds for $f,\tau,k,\mathcal A$
Every candidate's estimate differs from its true restricted Fourier weight by less than $\tau^2/4$
